description: The Ministry of Health requires stricter governance on malaria reporting. Configure the 'Malaria' dataset (e.g., 'Malaria Facility Report') in the Maintenance app with the following settings: (1) Set 'Days after period to qualify for timely submission' to 15 days. (2) Set 'Expiry days' (locking period) to 60 days. (3) Make the 'Malaria treated' data element compulsory to ensure it is always reported. Login credentials: admin / district.
